runs.label: Running orders
runs.name: Name
runs.empty: No running orders yet. Build the cue list for the next show day.
runs.emptyReadOnly: No running orders yet. The stage manager builds them before each show.
runs.noMatch: No running orders match this search. Clear it to see them all.
runs.deleteBody: Its cues go with it. Called cues stay in the activity history.

cues.title: Cues
cues.label: Cue
cues.empty: No cues yet. Add the first cue of the show.
cues.moveBody: Choose its new place in the running order. Called cues keep their places.

live.title: Live
live.complete: Every cue is called. The show is complete.
live.completeSkipped: The show is complete. {count, plural, one {# skipped cue is} other {# skipped cues are}} still uncalled.
live.notStarted: No cue called yet. Call the first cue to start the show.
live.noPlan: The next cue has no planned time.
live.syncing: Updates every two seconds while live.
live.readOnly: You can follow the show; calling cues needs the stage manager's permission.

daySheets.label: Day sheets
daySheets.bodyHelp: The schedule and notes everyone works from that day.
daySheets.empty: No day sheets yet. Write the plan for the next production day.
daySheets.emptyReadOnly: No day sheets yet. They appear here once the production office writes them.
daySheets.trashed: Day sheet for {project}, {day}, moved to Trash.

callSheets.label: Call sheets
callSheets.noCalls: No shifts start this day. Build shifts in Crew to fill the call sheet.
callSheets.empty: No call sheets yet. Create one for the next show day; calls come from its shifts.
callSheets.emptyReadOnly: No call sheets yet. They appear here once a producer publishes them.
callSheets.trashed: Call sheet for {project}, {day}, moved to Trash.
callSheets.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No calls} one {# call} other {# calls}}

cueShift.title: Shift cues still to come
cueShift.all: Select all cues still to come ({count})
cueShift.minutesHelp: Later with +, earlier with -, up to 1,440.
cueShift.invalid: Enter whole minutes other than 0, such as +5 or -10, up to 1,440.
cueShift.apply: Shift {count, plural, one {# cue} other {# cues}}
cueShift.preview: {count, plural, one {# cue moves} other {# cues move}} {minutes} min; {called, plural, one {# called cue stays} other {# called cues stay}}.
cueShift.refused: {count, plural, one {# cue can't move, so nothing changes} other {# cues can't move, so nothing changes}}
cueShift.done: {count, plural, one {Shifted # cue} other {Shifted # cues}} {minutes} min.
cueShift.undone: The cue times are back as they were.
cueShift.failed: The cues could not be shifted. Try again.

console.label: Showcaller console
console.jumpBody: Choose the cue to put on standby. Cues you jump past are marked skipped once a later cue is called.
console.nudgeEarlierLabel: Nudge the remaining plan one minute earlier
console.nudgeLaterLabel: Nudge the remaining plan one minute later
console.keys: Keys answer while the console has focus. Stream Deck keys F13 to F20 work even with single-key shortcuts off.

cueGrid.title: Running order as a grid
cueGrid.label: Cues after the last called cue
cueGrid.help: Type a row per cue in running order. Time reads shorthand such as 830p or 20:30 on the project's clock ({zone}), and +1 marks the next day; Duration takes 45, 45m or 1h30. Typing in the last row adds a cue. Save shows what would change; Apply writes every row or none.
cueGrid.called: {count, plural, one {# cue keeps its place: it is called, or comes before the last called cue} other {# cues keep their places: they are called, or come before the last called cue}}
cueGrid.preview: {created, plural, one {# new} other {# new}}, {changed, plural, one {# changed or moved} other {# changed or moved}}, {refused, plural, =0 {nothing refused} one {# refused} other {# refused}}.
cueGrid.badTime: This time does not read. Try 830p, 20:30 or 00:15 +1.
cueGrid.badDuration: This length does not read. Try 45, 45m or 1h30.
cueGrid.fix: {count, plural, one {Fix the cell marked before saving.} other {Fix the # cells marked before saving.}}
